signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: This editor works without an account — your config is kept in this browser. Signing in adds two things:
signIn.benefitSave: Configs saved on the server, so you can pick them up on another machine.
signIn.benefitSubscribe: Subscription URLs your devices pull directly, without this page open.
signIn.privacy: GitHub is asked only for your public profile — no repository access — and the access token is discarded once you are signed in.

error.notConfigured: GitHub sign-in is not configured. Set VITE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID in .env.local to your OAuth app's client ID.
error.state: That sign-in did not start in this tab, so it was refused. Please sign in again.
error.exchange: GitHub did not accept that sign-in. Please try again.
error.tooFast: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running.

save.title: Save to cloud
save.name: Name
save.nameHint: Two of your configs cannot share a name. It also names the file your devices download.

details.title: Config details
details.hint: Shown here right away. It reaches your account the next time you save.

configs.title: My configs
configs.intro: Configs saved on the server. Each one opens in its own tab.
configs.empty: Nothing saved yet. Start a new config, then save it from the editor.
configs.deleteNote: Deleting a config also stops every subscription URL pointing at it.

links.title: Subscription links
links.intro: Each link is a URL your proxy client fetches directly. Anyone holding one can read this config, including its proxy passwords — so give every device its own, and rotate the one that leaks.
links.notRendered: This config has never been exported. Save it once from the editor, or these links will have nothing to serve.
links.label: Label

serverShares.title: Server config shares
serverShares.intro: Each link serves one payload and always reflects the server config's latest saved state — edit the config, and the same links serve the new contents.
serverShares.typeFullHint: Exports this server config's raw Mihomo server document (listeners etc.).
serverShares.typeClientHint: Converts every convertible listener on this config into a client proxies list.
serverShares.notRendered: This config has nothing to share yet. Save it once from the editor, or these links will have no content to serve.

error.unreachable: The server could not be reached.

DOMAIN.description: Matches the full domain name exactly.

DOMAIN-WILDCARD.description: Wildcard domain. Only * (any run of characters) and ? (exactly one character) are supported.

DOMAIN-REGEX.description: Regular expression matched against the request domain.

GEOSITE.description: Picks a category from the Geosite database (v2fly domain-list-community).

IP-CIDR.description: Target IP range in CIDR notation. Pair with no-resolve to avoid DNS resolution.

DST-PORT.description: Matches the destination port or port range of the request.

SRC-PORT.description: Matches the source port or port range of the request.

IN-PORT.description: Matches the inbound listener port that received the connection.

IN-TYPE.description: Matches the inbound type, several separated by /, e.g. SOCKS/HTTP.

IN-USER.description: Matches the inbound auth username; several may be joined with /.

REMATCH-NAME.description: Matches the name written by a rematch outbound proxy.

PROCESS-PATH.description: Matches the sending process's full executable path (local traffic only).

PROCESS-PATH-WILDCARD.description: Process path with wildcards; only * and ? are supported.

PROCESS-PATH-REGEX.description: Regular expression matched against the process path.

PROCESS-NAME.description: Matches the sending process name (package name on Android).

PROCESS-NAME-WILDCARD.description: Process name with wildcards; only * and ? are supported.

PROCESS-NAME-REGEX.description: Regular expression matched against the process name.

UID.description: Matches the Linux user ID of the sending process.

NETWORK.description: Matches the transport protocol: tcp or udp.

DSCP.description: Matches the DSCP tag (tproxy UDP inbound only).

RULE-SET.description: References a rule-provider by name; the provider must be defined.

AND.description: Logical AND over sub-rules. Payload is a parenthesised list like ((DOMAIN,baidu.com),(NETWORK,UDP)) — mind the parentheses.

OR.description: Logical OR over sub-rules, written as a parenthesised list — mind the parentheses.

NOT.description: Negates a sub-rule written as a parenthesised list — mind the parentheses.

SUB-RULE.description: Jumps into a named sub-rules block; payload starts with the condition.

MATCH.description: Fallback rule matching every request. It has no payload and should stay last.
